header.scope: Docs-only audit of every runtime surface where process success could be promoted to business/outcome success. No runtime changes made.

surfaces.current_semantics: Builds BrokerExecutionResult with success = !timed_out && !cancelled && exit_code == Some(0). Process-level spawn fact only; no business outcome semantics.
surfaces.note: The trusted receipt builder. CP8 must keep it the only receipt source and feed it into the outcome pipeline, never promote its success field alone.

surfaces.current_semantics: Receipt wire struct is Deserialize-able; no production path ingests caller-shaped receipts (no IPC or store deserialization of receipts).
surfaces.note: Deserialize must never become an ingestion path. Any future code that deserializes caller JSON into BrokerExecutionResult and treats it as a receipt is CP8 FAIL.

surfaces.current_semantics: gh machine output parsed only when success && exit_code == Some(0), not timed out/cancelled, stdout untruncated; malformed JSON rejected (GhJsonInvalid); exit 4 maps to auth error.
surfaces.note: Fail-closed machine-output parsing, not outcome verification. Exit-0-gated parsing already rejects truncated and malformed output.

surfaces.current_semantics: Structured read outputs. IssueOutput carries state (OPEN/CLOSED strings); PrOutput carries state plus mergeable/merge_state_status but no mergedAt/mergeCommit; no comments field on issues.
surfaces.note: These read outputs are the raw material for future readback predicates. Gap catalog: issue comments missing, PR merge metadata missing.

surfaces.current_semantics: Read-only broker status aggregate. Exposes no receipts, outcomes, observations, or execution.
surfaces.note: Must remain read-only. Leaking receipt/outcome content through status is a fail.

surfaces.current_semantics: Command registry contains no executePlan, no readback, no receipt/observation ingestion, no outcome mutation commands.
surfaces.note: Adding a WebView-reachable generic readback or execute IPC is BLOCKS_CP8.

surfaces.current_semantics: Validation gate + runner call. Returns BrokerExecutionResult to the in-process caller (production callers: none; tests only). No outcome recording.
surfaces.note: The natural hook point for post-execution outcome pipeline: receipt -> (future) readback -> predicate -> Outcome.

surfaces.current_semantics: Five CP4 read-only bindings; zero production write bindings.
surfaces.note: CP8 requires production write bindings remain 0. Any write binding added during CP8 is a fail-oracle violation.

surfaces.current_semantics: Seals verification_plan (capability id + inputs) into the CP7 approval binding digest; any post-approval verification plan mutation breaks the digest.
surfaces.note: Binding only; nothing executes the verification plan. CP8 reuses this sealing for verification inputs.

surfaces.current_semantics: Verification capability id + inputs ride on the plan and the approval digest; no executor exists for them.
surfaces.note: CP8 must define how a verification plan becomes a broker-run readback (read-only binding) and an observation.

surfaces.current_semantics: Declarative read-back capability pointer with schema rules (differs from self, read-only capabilities must not declare rollback). No runtime enforcement that the referenced verifier is read-only at execution time.
surfaces.note: CP8 runtime must enforce: verifier resolves from the trusted catalog, is side_effect_class read_only, and produces no business side effect.

surfaces.current_semantics: Server-owned plan authorization lifecycle; carries verification_plan through approval and binding. No outcome recording, no readback execution.
surfaces.note: CP8 outcome linkage must consume the approved verification plan from here, never from a caller-supplied override.

surfaces.current_semantics: Journals caller/LLM-authored free-text actual_outcome into decision metadata and entities; explicitly does not modify principles.
surfaces.note: Free-text decision journal. Must never be read as verified execution outcomes; any future promotion of these records into CP8 verified outcomes is CP8 FAIL.

surfaces.current_semantics: LLM reviews outcome text and draws lessons ("never changes principles from a single observed result").
surfaces.note: LLM reflection is journaling, not verification. CP8 V1 forbids LLM_JUDGE: model text can never mark an outcome verified.

surfaces.current_semantics: Receipts are returned in-memory to the caller; no durable receipt store, no append-only outcome history exists yet.
surfaces.note: CP8 requires durable append-only receipt/outcome history; corrupt store fails closed and never resets empty.

surfaces.current_semantics: No IPC surface accepts receipts, observations, or outcome records; execute IPC stays disabled.
surfaces.note: Absence verified. Any public generic readback/execute IPC is BLOCKS_CP8.
